*Hint: Use the parametrization $r(t)=2\operatorname{cos}⁡t\,i+4\operatorname{sin}⁡t\,j.$*

Question 12
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫CF(r)⋅dr, where F(x,y)=2xi+5yj and C is the the arc of the ellipse centered at the origin with horizontal and vertical semiaxes 2 and 4 respectively, traversed anticlockwise from A(2,0) to B(0,4).

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=2cos⁡ti+4sin⁡tj.

a
∫0π/2(cos⁡t+1)sin⁡tdt
b
72∫0π/2sin⁡tcos2⁡tdt
c
27∫0π/2sin⁡tcos⁡tdt
d
27∫0π/2sin2⁡tcos⁡tdt
e
72∫0π/2sin⁡tcos⁡tdt
